title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
QAT Global, a 30+ year IT consulting firm based in the US, is seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer (Kafka / CDC / AWX) with strong English communication skills. This position will work directly with the customer located in the US and with development teams in our US, Costa Rica, and Brazil locations.


  • This opportunity can be 100% remote


Project Context

You will be working on a Unified Reporting Platform , responsible for capturing real-time data changes from multiple systems and publishing them to Kafka (Amazon MSK) .


Source Systems:

  • SQL Server (Direct)
  • PostgreSQL (Gateway)
  • PostgreSQL (Payments / Tokenization)


Core Stack:

  • Debezium (CDC)
  • Kafka (Amazon MSK – Kafka 3.x)
  • Schema Registry
  • AWS ECS Fargate
  • Dead Letter Queue (DLQ)


Responsibilities:

  • Design, configure, and maintain Debezium connectors (SQL Server and PostgreSQL)
  • Ensure reliable CDC pipelines with low latency and high data integrity
  • Manage Schema Registry and schema evolution strategies
  • Implement and monitor Dead Letter Queues (DLQ)
  • Perform testing, validation, and troubleshooting of data pipelines
  • Monitor pipeline performance, lag, and data consistency
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure data quality and reliability


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven experience with Debezium in production environments
  • Strong understanding of Change Data Capture (CDC) concepts
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka (topics, partitions, offsets, consumers)
  • Experience with SQL Server CDC and/or PostgreSQL logical replication
  • Familiarity with Schema Registry and schema evolution
  • Experience troubleshooting data pipelines in production
  • Ability to work in distributed systems and cloud environments


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Amazon MSK
  • Experience running workloads on AWS (ECS, Fargate)
  • Experience with DLQ patterns and data validation strategies
  • Background in event-driven architectures


Key Technical Skills:

  • Debezium
  • CDC (Change Data Capture)
  • Kafka / MSK
  • PostgreSQL / SQL Server
  • Schema Registry
  • AWS


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with high-volume, real-time data pipelines
  • Experience with observability and monitoring (lag, throughput, failures)
  • Experience in financial or payment systems
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

title: Service Desk Specialist
description:
Servicedesk SME - English & Spanish

Brazil (Remote)

Fulltime


Primary Work Environment

This position will be a resource for level 1 and level 2 support analysts to resolve problems requiring a greater level of technical expertise and/or time. Level 3 support analysts can expect to spend most of their time researching and resolving technical problems/issues and may be required to work as primary Level 1/2 staff if shorthanded. Technical information training and dissemination to global service desk staff is key for this role. Responsibility for creating, updating, and reviewing Solutions Center owned knowledge base documents is a normal daily activity. There may be large/small project involvement when Solutions Center resources are needed, or information needs to be disseminated to Solutions Center staff globally. This position will require frequent interaction between Solutions Center staff, other IT groups, and management. Travel to other sites to address end user issues may be required.

Responsibilities

  • Internal service desk escalator for issues requiring more extensive troubleshooting, investigation, or time for resolution.
  • Advanced end user technical resolution on items such as PC hardware and software issues; software installations and upgrades.
  • Provide advanced support duties for applications, network, server, and security functions where interaction is required with the appropriate IT functional teams all in support of addressing end user issues. This generally coincides with advanced privileges in various areas.
  • Support for labs, special builds, VIPs, and emergency support on a scheduled or ad hoc basis; often at the request of the Solutions Center Manager / Team Lead (as needed).
  • Population and maintenance of Solutions Center owned knowledge base documents.
  • Proactive recognition and resolution of end user and IT support issues to maintain a high level of visibility within the end user community.
  • Participate in projects and incident reviews that will enhance the quality of the Solutions Center service level and promote technical and career growth.
  • Participate in interview process for level 1 and 2 support analysts in region (where applicable).
  • Train all new regional Solutions Center and support staff.
  • Coach, mentor and educate level 1 and level 2 support analysts on critical thinking, end user experience and technical skills to solve end user issues.
  • Perform data center support tasks supporting follow the sun model (where applicable).
  • Fill in for primary level 1 and 2 solutions center tasks when needed based on volume, staffing or emergency.
  • Attend global team meetings when needed (may be off hours).
  • Perform Major Incident Escalation Coordinator activities to ensure a timely and efficient resolution of incidents that are impacting the business (may be off hours).


Thanks,

title: Lead Application Support Engineer
description:
MUST BE LOCATED IN BRAZIL


Position: Lead App Support Engineer – Sales Platform

Duration: 12-month Contract

Hours: 8 – 5PM EST

Pay Rate: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Must Haves:

  • 5+ years in Production Support, SRE, or Application Operations
  • Strong debugging skills with Node.js and React/Angular
  • Experience with MongoDB and SQL Server
  • Familiarity with APM, logging, and monitoring tools
  • Strong communication skills and ability to lead incident resolution


Plusses:

  • Experience with Ionic mobile or hybrid applications
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow IMT & RCA workflows
  • Familiarity with CI/CD processes and pipelines


Day to Day:

  • Monitor production applications to ensure stability, performance, and availability
  • Lead and participate in incident triage, troubleshooting, and resolution
  • Analyze system failures and apply break‑fix code or configuration changes as needed
  • Validate fixes in lower environments and coordinate with engineering for long‑term solutions
  • Perform proactive health checks, performance tuning, and reliability improvements
  • Support release activities and ensure smooth and compliant deployments
  • Provide clear communication and reporting to stakeholders during and after incidents


Day to Day:

Insight Global is seeking a Lead App Support Engineer to support a large health insurance client of ours. The Application Support Engineer plays a critical role in ensuring the stability, availability, and performance of core enterprise applications. The engineer will lead incident response efforts, perform proactive monitoring, troubleshoot complex issues, and implement break‑fix solutions to restore service quickly and prevent recurrence. This role also partners closely with development, QA, and infrastructure teams to drive continuous improvement and maintain operational excellence. Strong analytical skills, technical depth, and clear communication are essential to success.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Incident Management & On‑Call: Lead rapid incident response, drive MTTA/MTTR improvements, and coordinate multi‑team engagements
  • Monitoring, Observability & Reliability: Maintain and enhance dashboards, alerts, and performance indicators
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Management: Conduct deep‑dive analysis, identify root causes, and drive corrective actions
  • Break‑Fix Implementation: Diagnose issues, develop and deploy break‑fix solutions, validate changes, and ensure stable production operation
  • Change & Release Support: Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams for deployments, validations, and post‑release monitoring
  • Communication & Reporting: Provide status updates, incident summaries, and performance reporting to leadership and stakeholders
  • Governance & Best Practices: Adhere to operational standards, documentation requirements, and continuous improvement frameworks

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

title: Desenvolvedor ServiceNow | Especialista Técnico de Aplicações
description:
Descrição da Vaga (JD):

O desenvolvedor ServiceNow fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do ServiceNow. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.


Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar:

▪ Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.

▪ Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação.

▪ Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações.

▪ Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada.

▪ Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações.

▪ Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM).

▪ Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação.

▪ Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM.

▪ Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.

▪ Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.

▪ Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.

▪ Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.

▪ Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.

Qualificações e Requisitos


Qualificações essenciais

• Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada

• Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)

• Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos


Competências-chave

▪ 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI

▪ Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript

▪ Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor

▪ Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB

▪ Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects

▪ Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs

▪ Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável


Outras habilidades e competências

▪ Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado

▪ Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão

▪ Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
LOUCOS POR INOVAÇÃO E TRANSFORMAÇÃO:


A .add é uma empresa de TI e inovação, com 25 anos no mercado. Estamos localizados no São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro e Miami. Com atuação marcante no mercado brasileiro, desenvolvemos soluções eficientes de forma singular para entregar os melhores serviços e produtos nas áreas de Inovação e Tecnologia. Nosso diferencial está na expertise de um time multidisciplinar e comprometido com as melhores práticas ágeis utilizadas para superar desafios corporativos e garantir resultados extraordinários com precisão, agilidade e segurança.

Tecnologia, Liderança, Agilidade, Inovação e Pessoas, são os pontos que formam a essência da .add.


Aqui na .add você vai encontrar:

  • Ambiente colaborativo
  • Remoto
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Auxílio Alimentação
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Circuito de treinamentos
  • Programa de Educação Continuada
  • Desafios e oportunidades de crescimento

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações back-end em Java, com foco em arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Springboot;
  • Integrar e manter fluxos de mensagens com Apache Kafka;
  • Construir e consumir APIs RESTful;
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis utilizando serviços da AWS;

  • Participar de discussões técnicas, revisões de código e decisões de arquitetura;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares (devs, QA, produto, etc.);

title: Data Governance Architect
description:
N-iX is a global software development company founded in 2002, connecting over 2,400+ tech professionals across 40+ countries. We deliver innovative technology solutions in cloud computing, data analytics, AI, embedded software,IoT, and more to global industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Join us to create technology that drives real change for businesses and people across the world.

The Data Governance Architect will be responsible for creating and executing a cross-functional enterprise data program that supports overlapping data needs across tax, finance, and operations. This role requires strong leadership, deep hands-on technical skills (ETL, data modeling, SQL, MDM), and the ability to leverage platforms like Databricks for enterprise data solutions. A critical aspect is acting as a liaison with key business leaders to ensure data initiatives directly drive business value and compliance. Working hours: US business hours till 4 PM ET.


Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute a forward-thinking data governance strategy and roadmap. Build a scalable, adaptive framework that ensures compliance while facilitating the adoption of AI and GenAI technologies.
  • Lead the end-to-end development of enterprise ontologies and knowledge graphs, including schema design, reasoning rules, and alignment. Create scalable semantic models using RDF/OWL/SPARQL .
  • Integrate structured and unstructured sources into the semantic layer through schema mapping and harmonization. Conduct ontology validations, entity reconciliation, and SPARQL-based quality checks.
  • Oversee data cataloging, provenance, master data management (MDM), and metadata management. Establish standards for versioning control and change management.
  • Facilitate cross-departmental initiatives to establish a common data language. Provide insights on data investments and promote best practices across technical and functional teams.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent.
  • 10+ years in data management/governance with a proven record in leadership roles.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in ontology engineering and knowledge graph development . Advanced proficiency in RDF, OWL, and SPARQL
  • Practical experience with Stardog, Metaphacts, or GraphDB
  • Proficiency in platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Topbraid EDG, Erwin, or LeanIX.
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with Python for automation.
  • Strong understanding of integrating relational, NoSQL, and semi-structured data. Experience with cloud environments (Azure preferred).
  • Demonstrated success in transforming data practices within large, complex organizations and leading cross-functional teams.


Will be a plus:

  • Experience with reasoning engines, inference rules, and schema harmonization.
  • Familiarity with Google Knowledge Graph tools (Schema Tool, Critique, Cider).
  • Domain modeling experience in cloud infrastructure, software, or asset management.
  • Certifications in Azure or semantic technologies (Stardog, Metaphacts).



We offer*:

  • Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
  • A competitive salary and good compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location-specific benefits

*not applicable for freelancers

title: Desenvolvedor RPA Sênior
description:
Buscamos um Desenvolvedor RPA Sênior com sólida experiência em automação de processos utilizando tecnologias Open Source, visão computacional e integração com sistemas legados. O(a) profissional será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e sustentar soluções de automação robustas e escaláveis, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional e a evolução tecnológica dos nossos produtos e serviços. Valorizamos a atuação colaborativa, o pensamento arquitetural e a capacidade de propor melhorias contínuas em um ambiente dinâmico e orientado a resultados.


Responsabilidades:


  • Projetar, desenvolver, testar e manter automações utilizando ferramentas Open Source;
  • Implementar soluções com visão computacional e OCR para extração e tratamento de dados;
  • Automatizar fluxos em sistemas legados , incluindo integração com ambientes 3270;
  • Integrar sistemas via APIs , mensageria e componentes de automação de navegador;
  • Aplicar boas práticas de arquitetura (incluindo CQRS ) e padrões de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares, atuando em ciclos ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Monitorar, otimizar performance e garantir a confiabilidade das automações em produção.


Requisitos Obrigatórios (Experiência comprovada):


  • Ferramentas de automação OpenSource;
  • AutoIt;
  • OpenCV;
  • Tesseract OCR;
  • PW3270 / HLDLL;
  • Selenium;
  • SHDocVW (automação do componente WebBrowser);
  • CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation).


Conhecimentos Desejáveis:


Desenvolvimento & Arquitetura:


  • C# / .NET Framework / .NET Core;
  • WPF , HTML , JavaScript , Web APIs;
  • DDD (Domain-Driven Design);
  • Conceitos e práticas de RPA.


Integrações & Mensageria:


  • RabbitMQ.


Banco de Dados & Versionamento:


  • SQL Server;
  • Git.


Métodos de Trabalho:


  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

title: Digital Web Experience Solution Architect
description:
Digital Web Experience Solution Architect

São Paulo, Brazil/Buenos Aires, Argentina


Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.


In this role, you will:

  • Architect & implement scalable, secure, performant, and resilient approaches for brand websites that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Use modern CMS systems and MACH principles
  • Enable personalization, performance optimization, and measurable business outcomes
  • Comply with CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and other data privacy and regulatory requirements
  • Manage current state documents including diagrams, operational runbooks, and future-state roadmaps
  • Align digital marketing strategies within the platform architecture and guidelines.
  • Apply principles around people, process, information, and technology to design
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical specifications and architectural designs.
  • Provide Full-Stack technical leadership and guidance to development teams on modern CMS systems for building dynamic and high-performing sites, ensuring best practices are followed.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend new tools and technologies to enhance the digital experience.
  • Lead efforts to incorporate compliance features, such as consent management and secure data handling, into the architecture.
  • Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure that architectural designs align with regulatory requirements.
  • Stay current with industry trends in digital experience platforms and architecture, continuously evaluating emerging technologies and best practices to keep our brand experiences cutting-edge.
  • Provide guidance on selecting technologies and tools that also support compliance and data protection.
  • Operational Ownership to ensure uptime and reliability of all brand sites through proactive monitoring, incident management, and performance optimization including incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve architectural challenges, ensuring that solutions are scalable, secure, and performant.
  • Mentor and support other architects and engineers within the team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
  • Provide Legacy Support for existing sites during migration to MACH architecture where needed.


Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital experiences.


Required expertise in:

  • Full Stack Development (Frontend: React; Backend: CMS, API-first).
  • Modern CMS solutions (headless and traditional), integration patterns, and best practices.
  • MACH architecture (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless).
  • Cloud ecosystems (Azure or AWS) and cloud-native deployments.
  • Relational database design and optimization; advanced SQL skills.
  • Strong understanding of web technologies, frameworks, and security best practices.
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience integrating Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) for unified customer profiles and personalization.
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and real-time personalization through event-driven data flows.
  • Exposure to eCommerce systems, personalization engines, or digital marketing technologies.

title: SharePoint Developer (SPFx & Power Platform)
description:
About the job


Project Duration: 3 to 6 months

Engagement Type: Contract / Project-Based


We are seeking an experienced SharePoint Developer with strong expertise in SharePoint Online, SPFx, Nintex, and the Power Platform. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing customized SharePoint solutions, workflows, and business applications while supporting migrations and system integrations.

This role requires strong development skills in ASP.NET, C#, JavaScript, Web APIs, and SQL Server, along with experience in automation and modern SharePoint frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain solutions in SharePoint Online and On-Premises environments
  • Develop custom solutions using SPFx (SharePoint Framework), React, and TypeScript
  • Build and customize SharePoint Web Parts, Extensions, and Forms
  • Develop and maintain Nintex Workflows and Forms
  • Create and manage workflows using Power Automate
  • Build business applications using Power Apps (Canvas and Model-Driven)
  • Develop and consume RESTful Web APIs
  • Integrate SharePoint with third-party systems and Microsoft services (Graph API, Azure AD)
  • Perform SharePoint migrations (On-Prem to Online, File Share to SharePoint)
  • Develop backend components using ASP.NET, C#, and .NET Framework/Core
  • Write and optimize SQL Server queries, stored procedures, and views
  • Automate administrative tasks using PowerShell (PnP PowerShell)
  • Participate in solution architecture, requirement gathering, and technical documentation
  • Ensure compliance with governance, security, and best practices
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 3+ years of experience in SharePoint development
  • Strong experience with:
  • SharePoint Online & SharePoint Server
  • SPFx Framework
  • Nintex (Workflows & Forms)
  • Power Automate & Power Apps
  • ASP.NET / C#
  • JavaScript, HTML, CSS
  • SQL Server
  • Experience developing and consuming Web APIs
  • Experience with SharePoint migrations (ShareGate)
  • Strong knowledge of SharePoint security and permissions model
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting
  • Familiarity with Azure AD authentication and Microsoft Graph API


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps)
  • Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of React and modern front-end frameworks
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Microsoft certifications (SharePoint, Power Platform, Azure)


Technical Skills Summary

  • SharePoint Online & On-Prem
  • SPFx (React/TypeScript)
  • Nintex Workflows
  • Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate)
  • ASP.NET / C#
  • Web API Development
  • JavaScript / HTML / CSS
  • SQL Server
  • PowerShell
  • SharePoint Migrations

title: International Occupational Health Client Administrator
description:
International Occupational Health Client Administrator – Competitive Terms + Benefits – Remote, Brazil

The Role

We are currently seeking a highly motivated and organised individual to join our team as an International Occupational Health Client Administrator. In this role, you will be arranging medicals for senior employees of our clients and must have the highest customer services ethos. This is a fully remote position, and we welcome applications from candidates based in Brazil and internationally who will work the hours stated below. This position requires fluent English, both written and spoken. You will have 2+ years administration experience. Training, which is likely to last 3 months, will be conducted based on UK working days and times but the successful applicant will transfer to working BRT hours once fully trained.

This is self-employed position.

Key Responsibilities:

The key responsibilities of an International Occupational Health Client Administrator include, but are not limited to:

  • Administration of our medical appointment and recall systems.
  • Making appointments for clients via our clinical networks and ensuring that all instructions to clients and providers are issued timeously.
  • Dealing with clients, including non-native English speakers by telephone and email.
  • Recording and management of sensitive medical data.
  • Assisting with client management reporting.
  • Sourcing international medical providers who can perform the medicals we require and maintaining databases of provider qualifications and competencies.

The Company

Bcerta Ltd is an International Occupational Health service provider in 90+ countries for some of the world’s largest companies. We assist our clients in determining their employees' Fitness for Duty by establishing medical standards and managing the complexities of dealing with health in multiple jurisdictions.

The Benefits

  • Competitive terms.
  • Company contribution to cover state or private health insurance.
  • 30 days holiday per annum (pro-rata for part time) including local statutory holidays in your country.

The Person

The key skills and qualities of an International Occupational Health Client Administrator are:

  • Ability to strictly follow training programme and learn new processes quickly.
  • Accuracy, confidentiality and professionalism.
  • Able to work under time/client pressures.
  • Able to demonstrate that you have a high specification and stable internet connection form your home.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft packages including Outlook, Word and Excel.
  • Strict adherence to IT security procedures.
  • Good customer service ethos, interpersonal skills and organisational skills.
  • Team worker who shows initiative and takes responsibility whilst adhering to process and procedures.
  • Self-motivated, multi-tasker who can manage shared and personal workload upon completion of training.
  • Previous experience of working in an occupational health or medical environment.
  • Ability to speak multiple languages would be an advantage.

If you are keen on joining this exciting, forward-thinking company and taking the next step in your career, then please click the apply now button to find out more.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Technical Learning Programs


  • Location : Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) Contract | Monthly Invoicing
  • Start : ASAP | Contract through December 2026


About SureSkills

SureSkills is a global leader in technical learning and enablement, partnering with major technology organisations including Google Cloud. We design and deliver advanced cloud training programs, hands-on labs, certification pathways, and scalable technical enablement initiatives worldwide.


About the Role

This is a cross-functional, delivery-focused role supporting high-impact Google-related initiatives.


You will work closely with internal business owners across:


  • Content Development (technical workshops)
  • Technical Lab Support (hands-on learning environments)
  • Budget management and reporting


This is structured project leadership — not direct people management. The role also involves regular interaction with stakeholders at Google, requiring clear communication, structured updates, and strong alignment management.


Ideal Profile

  • 5–10 years’ experience in project management
  • Experience delivering technical, digital, or learning programs
  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills
  • Comfortable engaging enterprise stakeholders
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Able to operate independently in a PJ contractor model


Backgrounds That Fit Well

  • Learning / Enablement Project Manager (technical programs)
  • Content Development PM for complex digital initiatives
  • Program Manager in consulting or partner ecosystems
  • Technical PM in cloud, SaaS, or infrastructure environments


What You’ll Do

Program Planning & Coordination

  • Build structured project plans and define milestones
  • Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies
  • Ensure alignment across multiple workstreams

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate lab and content development initiatives
  • Facilitate alignment meetings
  • Proactively resolve blockers

Google Stakeholder Engagement

  • Provide structured status updates
  • Clarify evolving requirements
  • Support delivery alignment between SureSkills and Google

Delivery Oversight

  • Monitor readiness of lab environments and learning assets
  • Coordinate QA and validation cycles
  • Support smooth program launch and rollout

Process Improvement

  • Contribute to scalable, repeatable delivery frameworks
  • Improve reporting, documentation, and visibility


This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to Google stakeholders and global cloud initiatives.


If you’re a structured, delivery-driven PM who enjoys working at the intersection of technology and learning, we’d love to hear from you

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Front end PL- Nextjs
description:
Código da vaga: 58330


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional de Front End PL - venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento front-end com Next.js .
  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento front-end em projetos em Contentstack ou frameworks similares
  • Domínio de JavaScript , TypeScript , HTML5 , CSS3 .
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de build como Webpack , Vite , Babel .
  • Familiaridade com acessibilidade (WCAG ), performance e SEO.
  • Experiência com Git e metodologias ágeis.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com ferramentas de desenvolvedor para gerenciar e migrar conteúdo de forma eficiente.


Diferenciais que valorizamos:

  • Experiência com design systems (Storybook, Figma).
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados (Jest, Cypress, Playwright).
  • Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD .
  • Interesse em contribuir com a evolução de produtos digitais, incluindo experiências com IA e frameworks de apps.
  • Experiência com engenharia de prompt aplicada ao desenvolvimento fullstack, utilizando IA como apoio na análise, compreensão e organização de integrações entre frontend e backend, incluindo mapeamento de serviços, endpoints e contratos de API já existentes, bem como uso prático de IDEs de programação com suporte a IA, como CloudCode, Cursor ou GitHub Copilot, de forma estruturada e alinhada às boas práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes corporativos de grande escala
  • Vivência com BFF (Backend for Frontend) e contratos de API
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade indireta (logs, métricas, Lighthouse)
  • Experiência com testes de acessibilidade automatizados (axe em CI)
  • Atuação em times que adotam documentação como contrato arquitetural
  • Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica , bloqueando código fora do padrão
  • Familiaridade com governança de frontend e revisão arquitetural
  • Experiência com funis críticos (ex: matrícula, checkout, formulários complexos)


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver interfaces ricas e performáticas utilizando Next.js, incluindo: Server Components como padrão, Route Handlers, SSR, SSG e ISR
  • Trabalhar com Contentstack para estruturar e entregar conteúdo dinâmico via APIs.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares para criar soluções escaláveis, acessíveis e otimizadas para SEO.
  • Participar da definição de arquitetura front-end, compondo sistemas modulares e reutilizáveis.
  • Integrar com APIs REST e GraphQL, garantindo fluidez e consistência na experiência do usuário.
  • Contribuir com boas práticas de desenvolvimento, testes automatizados e pipelines de CI/CD.



Modelo 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior/Especialista
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.


A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


O futuro do varejo da construção civil tá sendo construído agora — e pode ser com você.

title: PESSOA DESENVOLVEDORA POWER BUILDER
description:
O que buscamos?

Um profissional que atue bem em equipe e possua boa comunicação.


Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Desenvolvimento de implementações e correções;
  • Colaboração com times técnicos e funcionais para soluções eficientes e inovadoras;
  • Mentoria e orientação para desenvolvedores júnior e plenos, compartilhando conhecimentos e melhores práticas;
  • Revisão de código para garantir a qualidade e conformidade com os padrões, além de colaboração em projetos e desenvolvimento de soluções eficazes.
  • Conduzir reuniões de entendimento de requisitos junto a usuários;
  • Especificação de requisitos funcionais e técnicos;
  • Ter a capacidade de propor arquitetura para soluções sistêmicas;
  • Gerar modelo de dados relacional;
  • Implementar requisitos funcionais e não funcionais;
  • Implantar sistemas;
  • Atender chamados corretivos e evolutivos.
  • Atuar como apoio técnico a outros analistas;
  • Liderar pequenas equipes;
  • Metodologias Agile e Waterfall;
  • Gerenciar pequenos projetos.

Requisitos e qualificações

Tecnologias necessárias (sheet Bodyshop):

  • Linguagens: PL/SQL, PowerBuilder (preferencialmente versão 2012 ou superior) e XML;
  • Banco de Dados: Oracle - 12g ou superior (Core) e SQL Server;
  • Ambientes: MS Visual Studio, TFS - Team Foundation Server e Azure;
  • Ferramentas: PowerDesigner (modelos de dados), SQL Developer, MS Project e InfoMaker;
  • Integração: WebServices (PowerBuilder / VB .NET - publicados no IIS), APIs, Arquivos Texto, XML, XLS, DBLinks, Conexões diretas a Banco de Dados;
  • Ensino Superior em Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas afins.


Horário da Vaga:

  • Das 08:00 as 17:30 de segunda a sexta-feira - com 1 hora e 30 minutos de almoço.
  • Modelo de trabalho: CLT - 100% remoto.


OBS.: Hey! Caso você não preencha todos os requisitos da vaga, te convidamos a se candidatar mesmo assim, ok? Faremos uma análise cuidadosa do seu perfil considerando todas as suas qualificações

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Vaga para Professor(a) de Inglês – Remoto

A Takemoto English School está em busca de um(a) professor(a) de inglês apaixonado(a) pela educação, para ministrar aulas particulares de inglês para adultos, com flexibilidade de horários. Se você é comprometido(a) e deseja contribuir para uma experiência de ensino personalizada e dinâmica, esta vaga é para você!

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Preparar e ministrar aulas de inglês para adultos, de acordo com as necessidades de cada aluno;
  • Executar as aulas baseadas nos materiais pedagógicos fornecidos pela escola;
  • Seguir os Protocolos Pedagógicos da Takemoto English School, mantendo o alto padrão de qualidade do ensino.

Requisitos:

  • Inglês em nível C1 (CEFR);
  • Experiência com aulas de inglês particulares;
  • Carga horária flexível, com disponibilidade para aulas no período da manhã e/ou noite;
  • Boa conexão de internet e câmera webcam funcional;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho remoto durante a noite e manhã.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com aulas particulares de inglês online;
  • Possuir MEI (Microempreendedor Individual).

Oferecemos:

  • Trabalho remoto, com flexibilidade de horários;
  • Valores de R$33 a R$37 por hora/aula.

Se você é motivado(a), tem experiência no ensino de inglês e deseja atuar em um ambiente inovador e flexível, envie seu currículo para se juntar à nossa equipe!

title: UI/UX Graphic Designer | Remote | Brazil | Full-Time
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right. We’re seeking experienced, creative graphic designers to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.



What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for team players who live and breathe design. People who are creative powerhouses and thrive on pushing boundaries and finding ways to bring fresh ideas to life. Ready to join our team and start designing?


About You


  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re a problem-solver, always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.
  • You’re a time management wizard.
  • You’re a team player
  • Communication is your jam—clear, concise, and always spot-on.
  • You’re resourceful—if you don’t know something, you don’t flinch. You’ve got Google, you’ve got grit, and you always figure it out.
  • Bonus points if you geek out on things like DND, Pokémon, or video games. Our team’s got some serious nerd cred, and we’re looking for like-minded peeps to join!


Qualifications and Skills


  • 2+ years of hands-on design experience—show us your growth and expertise
  • Proficiency in Figma and Webflow. You know the ins and outs of these tools like your favourite video game’s cheat codes
  • Mastery of the Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign—you live and breathe these tools.
  • A killer design portfolio that shows off your best work.
  • Working level of English (enough to communicate your ideas clearly, both in writing and speaking).
  • A bachelor’s degree is a plus.
  • Comfortable with Microsoft Office & Google Workspace (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and their Google equivalents).
  • Comfortable designing for various media—digital, print, and even big formats.
  • Eager to dabble with AI in your workflow, and you’re open to new tech that enhances your creativity.
  • Know your way around social media graphics formatting—you get the vibe.
  • A knack for creating cohesive designs from brand identity guidelines (without breaking a sweat).
  • You can whip up mockups for design presentations like a true pro.


Bonus Points


  • You worship Canva or other online tools like it’s your creative playground.
  • You’re into AI design tools—we think they’re pretty rad, and you should too!



Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
Altimetrik is a leading digital business enablement company. Our agile professionals and engineering teams craft innovative solutions that drive transformation and growth for businesses worldwide.


Are you ready to join an exceptional team? This is your opportunity to elevate your career with Altimetrik.


We are looking for a Senior Python Developer (Contractor) to join a high-impact environment, working on cloud-native, backend-oriented products within modern distributed systems.

Modality: Remote

️ English level: Advanced (B2/C1)

Position type: Full-time — Professional Services Contract


Responsibilities

• Develop, build, and optimize Python-based backend services

• Create and maintain scalable APIs using Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django)

• Work with AWS cloud services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, EKS, EC2, S3)

• Design resilient software components for distributed systems

• Implement containerized solutions using Docker & Kubernetes

• Write unit tests and maintain high standards of code quality

• Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to deliver cloud-native solutions


Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in Python development

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS (Lambda, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, S3, EKS, EC2)

• Experience with Django and Flask

• Experience building APIs using FastAPI

• Solid experience with Docker and Kubernetes

• Experience writing self-testing code (unit tests)

• Ability to design scalable, resilient components in distributed architectures

• Advanced English (B2/C1)


What We Offer

Since this role is under a Professional Services Contractor model , compensation and benefits will be aligned accordingly for Brazil, ensuring competitive market rates.


If you enjoy working on backend systems, cloud technologies, distributed architectures, and solving real technical challenges, we’d love to hear from you.


Apply now and be part of the change!

description:

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Sobre o perfil:

Procuramos um profissional para ajudar a evolução do nosso ecossistema de dados baseado DeltaLake/Spark/Superset, governança, qualidade e performance. Papel hands-on, autonomia e impacto direto no negócio.

Responsabilidades:

• Desenvolver e operar pipelines escaláveis baseados em Python;

• Modelar dados, usando um arquitetura medalhão, otimizando custo e performance;

• Otimizar consultas, partições, índices e storage (Parquet/Delta);

• Monitorar saúde/custos dos pipelines e documentar arquitetura, fluxos e dicionário de dados.

Requisitos técnicos:

• SQL avançado e modelagem;

• Python, Spark, Deltalake e Arquitetura Medalhão;

• Desenvolvimento de pipelines em python e Airflow;

• Versionamento com GitHub e CI/CD;

• Métodos ágeis e comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e de negócio.

Diferenciais:

• Conhecimentos de Superset (implantação/uso);

• Conhecimento de Lakehouse;

• Boas práticas de Data Viz;

• Inglês técnico.

Obs.: Importante é menos foco microsoft e mais foco opensource, python, spark, airdlow, etc.

title: Consultor(a) de Viagens Internacional
description:
Consultor(a) de Viagens Internacional — Lua De Mel & Experiências Personalizadas (Brasil)


A Honeymooners é uma agência internacional especializada em luas de mel e viagens de alto valor , com forte presença no mercado dos EUA.


Esta não é uma vaga para atendimento turístico tradicional.

É para quem sabe aconselhar, conduzir decisões e vender viagens internacionais personalizadas a casais exigentes.


Estamos a construir o nosso canal internacional de consultoria de viagens e procuramos profissionais no Brasil com foco em viagens, ritmo comercial e ambição .

⸻

O que vais fazer :

• Atender e aconselhar casais internacionais (maioritariamente EUA) na criação da sua lua de mel;

• Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico, entendendo expetativas, estilo de viagem e prioridades;

• Trabalhar em articulação com a equipa interna de pós-vendas e orçamentação;

• Apresentar soluções de viagem personalizadas e conduzir o processo até ao fecho;

• Fazer follow-up estruturado e consistente;

• Trabalhar com metas claras de vendas;

• Registar toda a atividade no CRM.

⸻

Procuramos profissionais que:

• Tenham experiência real como consultor(a) de viagens ou em vendas de viagens personalizadas;

• Estejam confortáveis a vender viagens internacionais de valor médio/alto;

• Comuniquem em inglês funcional e confiante;

• Gostem de trabalhar com metas, ritmo e responsabilidade;

• Prefiram ganhar mais por performance do que ter garantias fixas;

• Tenham postura consultiva, mas saibam conduzir decisões;

• Não fiquem confortáveis sem pipeline ativo.


Esta vaga NÃO é indicada se:

• Procuras apenas atendimento ou operação turística;

• Precisas de salário alto garantido desde o primeiro mês;

• Não gostas de metas ou avaliação de performance;

• Preferes um ambiente previsível e sem pressão;

• Procuras um ritmo “tranquilo”.

⸻

Modelo de trabalho:

• Full-time;

• 100% remoto;

• Horário alinhado com o mercado dos EUA.

⸻

Processo de Recrutamento:

• Conversa inicial (perfil, ambição e fit);

• Simulação prática de atendimento/consultoria de viagem;

• Decisão rápida.

⸻

Oferecemos:

• Salário base + US$ 150 por cada lua de mel vendida;

• Modelo orientado a performance, com upside real para quem anda;

• Crescimento financeiro associado a resultados e consistência.

⸻

Somos uma agência de viagens internacional especializada em luas de mel e viagens personalizadas , fundada pelo casal Português Joana & André.

Trabalhamos com casais exigentes e viagens de alto valor, onde a atenção ao detalhe e a capacidade de conduzir decisões fazem a diferença.

Aqui não prometemos facilidade. Prometemos crescimento para quem aguenta ritmo e responsabilidade.

Envia o teu CV para:

title: Salesforce Configuration Specialist
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Salesforce Configuration Specialist to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.


This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only) , offering the chance to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


We are seeking a Salesforce Configuration Specialist with strong hands-on experience in complex configurations and data management. This role is focused on delivering scalable, high-quality solutions using declarative tools , with a strong emphasis on Flows, security, and data integrity .


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute advanced Salesforce configurations (Flows, Experience Cloud, automation, custom fields, permissions)
  • Manage data migration and ensure data quality and consistency
  • Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions
  • Troubleshoot configuration and data reconciliation issues
  • Provide training and create user/technical documentation
  • Build reports and dashboards for operational and leadership insights


Required Experience

  • Solid experience with Salesforce administration and configuration (not only certifications)
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • User management (roles, profiles, permission sets, security policies)
  • Data modeling and object relationships
  • Validation rules, formula fields, record types, list views
  • Flows (advanced level) and troubleshooting
  • Experience with SSO/SAML configuration and authentication setup
  • Proficiency in Data Loader, Data Import Wizard, and data quality management
  • Ability to differentiate data vs. configuration issues and replicate scenarios in sandbox environments
  • Experience building reports and dashboards


Preferred Profile

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience
  • Strong communication skills in English (client-facing environment)
  • Analytical mindset with a structured, problem-solving approach
  • Experience in B2B software environments


Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, or ISV development
  • Experience writing technical specifications


Why Join

  • Work on international projects with global clients
  • Exposure to complex, large-scale Salesforce environments
  • Collaborative and technically driven team


If you have a strong configuration background and can operate at depth without relying on code, this role is aligned with your profile.

title: Business Development Manager/Director
description:
PingPong is on a mission to digitize trade, simplifying global growth for businesses. With $300B+ in payments processed, we're one of the world’s leading cross-border platforms – and we’re just getting started.

PingPong currently has 38 offices in 15 countries and over 1,500 employees. Our international presence helps businesses solve complex payment needs in every major economy across all time zones.


Now, we're scaling and looking for a BD Manager/Director to own the strategy, pipeline, and partnerships that will power our next phase of growth.


WHAT’S THE CHALLENGE?


You will take ownership for growing our customers and revenue in the region. You’ll land high-impact deals with banks, fintechs, platforms and enterprises. You’ve got the commercial sharpness to close complex deals.


WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH


You’ll partner closely with our local Compliance, Product, Marketing and operations teams to build a cohesive user journey that delivers the right product to the right users, at the right time. You’ll also collaborate with colleagues across US, EU and other regions and with Group HQ teams.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING


  • Build and execute our BD strategy across the Latin America(Brazil) with a focus on financial institutions, platforms and enterprise clients.
  • Maintain a high-quality pipeline across identified target verticals, focusing on high-impact deals, and think through supporting business development strategies.
  • Own the full sales cycle for closing new partners – from sourcing and qualification to leading the definition of the solution for the partner and negotiating the commercials, all the way through to go-live.
  • Pitch our API-first platform, solving real cross-border pain points.
  • Lead commercial and legal negotiations with C-level execs.
  • Work to improve our go-to-market approach, refining messaging, pricing strategy, and pitch materials based on feedback from partners and insights about competitors.
  • Collaborate internally, sharing feedback and insights from the UK market to product teams and senior management to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
  • Continuously refine our go-to-market playbook based on what works.
  • Be the voice of the UK market internally – and help drive what comes next.


WHAT YOU BRING


  • Track record in BD, partnerships, or enterprise sales in fintech or financial services:
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions or regulated entities
  • Fluency in the world of payments, FX, embedded finance, or APIs.
  • Strategic thinker, hands-on doer, data-driven operator.
  • Able to speak the language of product, compliance, and commercial teams.


WHO YOU ARE


  • Educated with a relevant degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.
  • Customer-focused, you can’t imagine working in any other way, and it’s the only way to achieve our goals.
  • Equally at home in both strategic planning and hands-on execution, ideally with experience in start-up/scale-up as well as larger organisations.
  • Ability to drill down, persistent and never-give-up spirit.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute high-impact business development strategies.
  • Strong consultative sales approach and experience negotiating with enterprise C-level executives.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills – able to influence internal and external stakeholders


PingPong is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer with a global culture that embraces diversity.

  • We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment.

title: Emarsys Data Entry Consultant (Email Automation | Template Management | QA)
description:
Role: Emarsys Data Entry Consultant

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location: 100% Remote


We’re looking for an experienced Emarsys Data Entry Consultant to support email automation campaigns with a strong focus on Emarsys platform expertise . You’ll adjust templates, provide translations/localization , guide the Emarsys team on technical and regional requirements, and ensure accurate, high-quality automated campaigns .


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage and adjust Emarsys templates for automated campaigns
  • Perform translations and localization for emails
  • Prepare and manage JSON for all Emarsys email templates
  • Conduct testing and QA to ensure campaign accuracy
  • Provide guidance on technical or regional requirements to the Emarsys team
  • Handle transactional content (Order #, Billing Address, totals, discounts, etc.) accurately


Requirements:

  • Hands-on experience with Emarsys email automation platform
  • Experience in email template management, automation, and campaign workflows
  • Familiarity with translations/localization and handling English & Korean content
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry
  • Experience in testing and QA of email campaigns
  • Flexible with hours based on campaign complexity

title: Power BI/Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Power BI/Data Engineer (Clinical Projects)

Duration: 12 Month Contract, AOR

Hours: 40 hrs/week, EST Time Zone

Interview Process : 2 rounds - virtual

Location: Remote- LATAM

Required Skills & Experience

- 5+ years of experience with Power BI development and engineering (DAX and semantic model development and deployment)

- Strong hands on coding ability in PySpark and Python - Professional working experience with Databricks and Spark platforms

- Experience working in Microsoft Fabric

- Fair knowledge on the use of Azure Dev Ops (ADO) to manage repository and versions

- Strong communication skills and experience engaging directly with business stakeholders and technical teams

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

- Knowledge of Tabular and ALM tools to work on Semantic Model and automation

- Experience working for a global company/ with a global team

Job Description

A global biopharmaceutical company is seeking strong Power BI and Data Engineers to join their team to support a portfolio of ongoing clinical operations projects. These individuals will work on a team of Power BI Engineers of all levels and will partner with technical and functional partners to meet the project needs.

The ideal candidates should have in-depth expertise with Power BI (including DAX and Semantic Model Development), strong PySpark & Python coding experience, and experience with Databricks.

Additionally, all senior level resources should have proven working experience with and strong knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and should have experience with leading junior team members. Strong communication skills are a must along with the proven ability to work with cross functional teams and stakeholders to drive project work and all candidates should be eager to learn new skills.

title: Consultor SAP MM com inglês avançado - S/4 HANA
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como elo-chave entre a área de negócios e TI para processos relacionados a aquisições.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders de negócios para entender processos, identificar problemas e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Analisar fluxos de trabalho atuais e propor soluções de TI para aumentar eficiência e garantir conformidade.
  • Participar de projetos de TI relacionados a aquisição e procurement, garantindo que requisitos sejam capturados e soluções atendam aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Prestar suporte funcional para os módulos SAP MM e S/4HANA, incluindo troubleshooting e melhorias.
  • Analisar dados de aquisição para identificar tendências e gerar insights que apoiem decisões estratégicas.
  • Apoiar treinamentos e comunicação para garantir adoção efetiva de novas ferramentas e processos.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Conhecimento sólido em SAP MM e S/4HANA.
  • Habilidade analítica e capacidade de resolver problemas de forma estruturada.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Entendimento de processos de procurement e aquisição.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos e prioridades simultaneamente.
  • INGLES AVANÇADO/FLUENTE


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Engenheiro de Software Full Stack SR
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.


A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


O futuro do varejo da construção civil tá sendo construído agora — e pode ser com você.

title: Executive Assistant (Technical)
description:
Executive Assistant (Technical)

Salary: $800 - $1000 / month

Working Hours: Brazil Time

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location : Remote


About the Role

We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to support the founder across both traditional EA responsibilities and technical project coordination.


You’ll help keep day-to-day operations organized, while also translating ideas and conversations into clear work streams that developers can execute against.


We’re looking for someone product-minded — someone who thinks about how things should work, asks good questions, and cares about quality. If you’re highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with software tools and technical teams, this role is a strong fit.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support the founder with traditional executive assistant tasks (scheduling, organization, follow-ups, documentation, coordination)
  • Watch client calls or internal discussions and turn them into clear work streams and task lists
  • Explain to developers exactly what needs to be built and why
  • Test features and applications after development and document issues or improvements
  • Perform light setup and cleanup in tools like Airtable, Notion, and Excel / Google Sheets


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Strong organization and attention to detail
  • Experience in an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Project Coordinator, or Operations Support role
  • Comfortable using tools like Excel / Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, and task management tools
  • Able to communicate clearly with both non-technical and technical teammates


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience supporting US-based founders or agencies
  • Experience with no-code tools (Zapier, Make, N8N)
  • Prior exposure to QA / testing or software-related projects


Why Join Us?

  • Work directly with the founder
  • Get hands-on experience coordinating real software and automation projects
  • Build transferable skills in technical project coordination and operations

title: Executive Assistant (Technical)
description:
Executive Assistant (Technical)

Salary: $800 - $1000 / month

Working Hours: Brazil Time

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location : Remote


About the Role

We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to support the founder across both traditional EA responsibilities and technical project coordination.


You’ll help keep day-to-day operations organized, while also translating ideas and conversations into clear work streams that developers can execute against.


We’re looking for someone product-minded — someone who thinks about how things should work, asks good questions, and cares about quality. If you’re highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with software tools and technical teams, this role is a strong fit.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support the founder with traditional executive assistant tasks (scheduling, organization, follow-ups, documentation, coordination)
  • Watch client calls or internal discussions and turn them into clear work streams and task lists
  • Explain to developers exactly what needs to be built and why
  • Test features and applications after development and document issues or improvements
  • Perform light setup and cleanup in tools like Airtable, Notion, and Excel / Google Sheets


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Strong organization and attention to detail
  • Experience in an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Project Coordinator, or Operations Support role
  • Comfortable using tools like Excel / Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, and task management tools
  • Able to communicate clearly with both non-technical and technical teammates


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience supporting US-based founders or agencies
  • Experience with no-code tools (Zapier, Make, N8N)
  • Prior exposure to QA / testing or software-related projects


Why Join Us?

  • Work directly with the founder
  • Get hands-on experience coordinating real software and automation projects
  • Build transferable skills in technical project coordination and operations
  • Opportunity for increased responsibility over time
